prompt: Audit the public docs entry points for a developer tool. No Search Console is available. The developer-tool PLG article must remain unchanged.

Create a quickstart for a data API using synthetic records. You cannot run it here and no production credentials are authorized.
Assess agent readiness from public docs only. Vendor A has llms.txt and an MCP endpoint; vendor B has a documented CLI. No credentials or execution are allowed.

Evaluate per-seat versus per-request pricing for a CLI used heavily in CI. We have no delivery cost data yet. Do not change live billing.
We want to claim our query engine is 10x faster. We only have one warm-cache run, no correctness comparison, and a competitor default config.
An engineer likes our tool after a local demo, but platform and security approval remain. Write a champion brief, not an outreach email.
